title: Factorized token x domain Mirror embedding address
hypothesis: A shared token-logit table plus one Givens phase code per domain will generalize to held-out token-domain combinations under cyclic domain shifts, approaching a per-domain full linear map while using fewer actual bytes; it should outperform additive and rank-4 adapter controls if their function families cannot represent the phase shift compactly.
physical_object: one shared token embedding/logit table for 128 tokens
mirror_coordinate: one learned cyclic Fourier phase per domain, applied to the shared token representation
logical_multiplicity: eight domain-specific token functions generated from one physical token table

model.target: class=(token_id mod 8 + domain_id) mod 8; deterministic cyclic domain shift
model.held_out_split: seeded 25% token-domain pairs withheld uniformly, while every token and every domain remains represented in training
model.domain_identity: domain ID is an observed input for all methods; no withheld token-domain labels are used for training

controls: shared token table plus domain-specific additive class bias
shared token table plus per-domain rank-4 residual linear adapter and bias
shared token table plus full per-domain 8x8 linear map and bias
Mirror: shared token table plus one Fourier/Givens phase per domain
development_gate_before_fresh: For both seeds, on held-out token-domain pairs: Mirror accuracy within 0.03 of the full per-domain map and >=0.05 above additive and rank-4 controls; actual serialized Mirror payload <=0.80x full per-domain-map payload; and Mirror held-out NLL no more than 0.10 above the full per-domain map. Seen-pair quality and full independent-table control are reported but do not gate. Any gate miss keeps fresh sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds meet the held-out quality/NLL/bytes gates with exact payload reload replay; report seen/heldout quality, actual bytes, compute, wall clock and throughput.
failure_gate: Any held-out development gate misses in either seed; fresh remains unopened.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: independent table or shared token table
domain biases/maps/adapters or all Mirror phases

boundaries: synthetic cyclic domain-shift task, not natural recommendation or LM quality
held-out token-domain combinations are the primary measure
domain identity is input information shared by all methods
eight domains do not imply eight independent capacities
fresh data remain sealed until every development gate passes
